title: Уязвимость ядра CVE-2026-98432
summary: use-after-free in the IPv4 TCP SYN path when the SYN carries IP options; network-reachable, Ubuntu priority high
stopgap_note: nft rule drops inbound IPv4 TCP with IP options (upstream-system ops/server, ipv4-options-drop.service); remove with: systemctl disable --now ipv4-options-drop.service

title: Уязвимости ядра CVE-2026-74469 / 80844 / 81000 (получение root изнутри)
summary: three local privilege escalations with public exploits: SCTP diag (no namespaces needed), IPv6 AH and TUN (need user namespaces, softened by AppArmor); all fixed in 6.8.0-148
stopgap_note: modprobe refuses sctp/sctp_diag (/etc/modprobe.d/cve-2026-74469-sctp.conf, upstream-system ops/server); remove after 148+ runs. The other two have no stopgap beyond AppArmor's userns restriction.
